entries.back_en: Day 12. This world challenges the foundations on which all our religions are based — and not just that: our way of looking at life will never be the same again. Was it the will of the Gods that brought us here? If so, I reject it. If I must choose between them and my kingdom, I will accept any punishment they impose on me. Riva... How I long to see you again and tell you everything about the great beyond. Day 26. I have not ceased searching for the reason we were snatched from our lives in Zarga. I've thought of a thousand theories, but in the end I always return to the same point. Arkzel is not with us. Perhaps it's too soon to point fingers at a friend. May the Gods forgive me if my dark suspicions eclipse my trust. Day 33. Being infected by that parasite has changed me — of that there is no doubt. The feeling of suffocation gives way to defeat and submission. It plays with you, leaving you lucid one moment and in blind fog the next, manipulating your actions and thoughts. There is a strange sensation of power. It awakens abilities in you that you didn't even believe possible and exploits your potential. Living through that made me go back to thinking about Arkzel again. If that parasite awakened so much power in me... What could it do to someone like him? Was the earthquake just a coincidence? The more I think about it, the closer I get to believing it wasn't. I hope you're well, old friend.
entries.note: Meaning accurate but typo 'cesssei' (should be 'cessei'); minor gender assumption 'vê-lo' for Riva.
